object.attr: stakeholder: the commit messages say why the target changed. Bounded by ancestry rather than by date, so that a rebased or cherry-picked history isn't misread (CF-T43); built after 0.3.0 by matching git log <ack>..HEAD.
object.description: The MCP server's review_suspect_link tool shall return the commits that are the latest commit or its ancestors, aren't the acknowledged commit or its ancestors, and changed the target object's file or figure.
